args.body: Hi there! If you haven't already, please take a moment to complete your onboarding in the vendor portal. This will help us process payments more efficiently and securely. Let us know if you need assistance!

arguments.to: Greg Lam <greg.lam@lam.com>, Dana Whitfield <dana.whitfield@brightlineprint.com>, Ana Silva <ana.silva@silvaflorals.com>, Lena Hoffmann <lena.hoffmann@hoffmannav.com>, Tom Becker <tom.becker@beckerfreight.com>
arguments.subject: Reminder: Register on the Vendor Portal
arguments.body:
Hi there,

This is a friendly reminder to register on our new vendor portal. The portal makes it easier to submit invoices and track payments. If you need help, we can provide step-by-step instructions.

Thanks,
Harbor & Pine Consulting
